title: An upstream secondary DNA motif within the IL3 insulator CTCF binding site is required for enhancer-blocking insulator activity
authors: Sarion R. Bowers; Peter N. Cockerill
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CTCF蛋白与IL3绝缘子DNA基序的结合及其对增强子阻断活性的影响，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但主要依赖实验和序列分析，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测或动态机制建模，故评分为5。
abstract: CCCTC-binding Factor (CCTF) is the only known vertebrate protein that functions to organise the genome into distinct functional chromatin domains. A subset of CTCF sites also provide insulator activity and barrier activity to block inappropriate enhancer-promoter communication and spreading of histone modifications and non-coding transcription into loci where it is unwarranted. Paradoxically, other CTCF sites mediate enhancer and promoter communication, partly by supporting DNA loop extrusion within chromatin domains. Despite intensive study and abundant data, it remains poorly understood how CTCF directs these different functions. In this study we provide new data and mine published data that show that CTCF utilises zinc fingers 9 to 11 and an upstream DNA binding consensus sequence resembling CAGCTGTTCC to mediate high affinity binding and enhancer-blocking insulator activity. A single high affinity CTCF binding site from the IL3 locus is able block IL3 promoter activation by an upstream enhancer. Mutation of a CTGCAGCTTT sequence upstream of the CTCF core motif abolishes insulator activity. We propose that CTCF is able to confer insulator and barrier activity upon a specific subset of CTCF sites that contain the upstream DNA consensus binding motif, thereby allowing CTCF to function differently in different contexts.
abstract_zh: CCCTC结合因子（CCTF）是已知的唯一一种脊椎动物蛋白，其功能是将基因组组织成不同的功能性染色质结构域。一部分CTCF位点还提供绝缘子活性和屏障活性，以阻断不适当的增强子-启动子通讯，以及组蛋白修饰和非编码转录向不需要这些过程位点的扩散。矛盾的是，其他CTCF位点介导增强子和启动子通讯，部分通过支持染色质结构域内的DNA环挤出实现。尽管已有大量研究和丰富数据，但CTCF如何指导这些不同功能仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们提供了新数据并挖掘了已发表数据，表明CTCF利用锌指9至11以及一个类似于CAGCTGTTCC的上游DNA结合共识序列来介导高亲和力结合和增强子阻断绝缘子活性。来自IL3基因座的一个高亲和力CTCF结合位点能够阻断上游增强子对IL3启动子的激活。CTCF核心基序上游的CTGCAGCTTT序列突变会消除绝缘子活性。我们提出，CTCF能够对含有上游DNA共识结合基序的特定CTCF位点子集赋予绝缘子和屏障活性，从而使CTCF在不同环境中发挥不同功能。
